english.title: Cause / permit registration plate to be obscured with intent to avoid payment / fail pay charge imposed by scheme
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused or permitted the registration plate of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REGISTRATION..), to be obscured with intent to avoid payment of, or being identified as having failed to pay, a charge imposed by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(5)(b) and (8) of the Transport Act 2000.
